_note: Candidate registry for Wisconsin 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Wisconsin Elections Commission, All Contests and Candidates_November 3, 2026.xlsx (posted on the WEC Wisconsin Elections page, November 3, 2026 General Election files, page last modified 2026-10-06), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Wisconsin Elections Commission, All Contests and Candidates_November 3, 2026.xlsx (posted on the WEC Wisconsin Elections page, November 3, 2026 General Election files, page last modified 2026-10-06) (https://elections.wi.gov/media/41846/download); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
